_comment: Spring subject offerings, keyed by PROGRAM_CD (string).
'not_offered_slots' lists pattern positions (the number N in 'Subject N Status')
that do NOT run in Spring, so a student owing that subject carries it to a
later session instead of being advised into it now.
Only 9031 (Nursing) is seeded, and only because the source file shows a clean
full-population signal: across every student who still owes slots 1-4, not one
is registered for them in Spring - that program runs slots 1-4 in Autumn and
5-8 in Spring by design. Every other program is left empty on purpose: the
moderate 'sometimes skipped' rates elsewhere are noise, not a confirmed rule.
Replace/extend this from Josiah's handbook scrape when it lands.
'prep_not_offered': list of prep subject codes not offered in Spring (none known).
